reasoning: After reveal. The genuine claim differs from the planted control in one field only: operative_clauses[EO:11884#s5].first_end.date is 1975-10-07, not 1972-10-07. Re-checked on the same standard as the blind review. Hash and every quoted span match EO_11884.txt (0 mismatches). Identity: 40 FR 47469, Executive Order 11884 of October 7, 1975, coat of arms, seal and flag of the Vice President; the title matches the register (Ford). The five-clause inventory (sections 1 to 5) covers the whole order, and the 47470 specifications are part of section 4 by incorporation. Section 5 says the order takes effect immediately and revokes EO 10016 in the present tense, so it was performed on signing. The date 1975-10-07 now agrees with the order, the judgment_reason and the research_rationale. The OFR catalog records only "Revokes: EO 10016" on the order and "Revoked by: EO 11884" on EO 10016, with no note against EO 11884. Cruden finds only the 1989 snapshot, the current-law searches show 0 hits, and the catalog through EO 14435 shows nothing later. Sections 1 to 4 have no own-terms end, and no savings issue arises. Limit stated: the graphic content of the illustrations is not read.
